# CONTRIBUTING.md

```dsl
DOCUMENT CONTRIBUTING
VERSION 7
LANGUAGE PL
MODE PROCEDURAL
PURPOSE "proces pracy nad repozytorium"
POLICY "POLICY.md"
```

## LEGENDA DSL I REGUŁY INTERPRETACJI

Bloki `dsl` są normatywnym, czytelnym dla ludzi i agentów zapisem polityki;
nie są samodzielnie wykonywalnym językiem programowania. Deterministyczne
egzekwowanie realizuje walidator i manifest policy-as-code.

```dsl
DOCUMENT <NAME>                 # nazwa kontraktu
VERSION <INTEGER>               # wersja dokumentu DSL
MODE <STRICT|PROCEDURAL>        # sposób interpretacji
# <COMMENT>                     # komentarz objaśniający bez skutku normatywnego

RULE <STABLE_ID> [TYPE <TYPE>]  # początek reguły ze stabilnym identyfikatorem
WHEN <CONDITION>                # warunek aktywacji reguły
DO <ACTION>                     # wymagane działanie po aktywacji
DO REQUIRE <CONDITION>          # wymagany warunek lub dowód
DO ALLOW <ACTION>               # jawnie dozwolony wyjątek w podanych granicach
FORBID <ACTION>                 # bezwzględny zakaz po aktywacji
ASSERT <POSTCONDITION>          # warunek, który musi być prawdziwy po wykonaniu
NEXT <STATE> [OR BLOCKED]       # dozwolone przejście maszyny stanów
```

Semantyka:

1. Reguła aktywuje się tylko, gdy jej `WHEN` jest prawdziwe. Wszystkie jej
   linie `DO`, `FORBID`, `ASSERT` i `NEXT` obowiązują łącznie.
2. `TYPE REQUIRED` wymaga działania lub dowodu; `TYPE FORBIDDEN` blokuje
   wskazaną czynność. Brak `TYPE` w procedurze oznacza regułę wymaganą.
3. `AND` oznacza koniunkcję, `OR` alternatywę, `IN [...]` przynależność,
   `=` równość, `!=` nierówność, a `<=` limit włącznie. Nawiasy mają
   pierwszeństwo przed operatorami.
4. Wartości w cudzysłowie są literałami. Nazwy wielkimi literami oraz
   `{PLACEHOLDER}` są symbolami kontraktu i muszą zostać rozwiązane z
   bieżącego źródła prawdy; nie wolno zgadywać ich z nazwy.
5. `NEXT` nie zezwala na pominięcie stanu. Brak wymaganego dowodu prowadzi do
   `BLOCKED`, a zmiana zakresu wraca do `PLAN` i `WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL`.
6. Konflikty rozstrzyga kolejność źródeł z `POLICY.md`: polecenie
   użytkownika i bieżące pliki mają pierwszeństwo. Historia Git służy do
   odtworzenia kontekstu i kolejności, lecz sama nie może nadpisać aktualnego
   kontraktu ani stanowić zgody.

## SCOPE

```dsl
ROOT = ACTIVE_REPOSITORY
TASK_CONTEXT IN [GOVERNANCE_HUB_MAINTENANCE, TARGET_SYSTEM_DELIVERY]
GOVERNANCE_HUB = EDITABLE_STANDARD_SOURCE_WITH_TICKET
FILES_PRIMARY = [
  "CONTRIBUTING.md",
  "POLICY.md",
  "README.md",
  "AGENTS.md",
  "project.sh",
  "project.bat"
]

TICKET_ROOT = "active_repository/project"
TICKET_DIRECTORY_PATTERN = "project/ticket-{NNN}"
TICKET_INDEX_FILE = "project/TICKETS.md"
TICKET_SPEC_FILE = "project/ticket-{NNN}/README.md"
TICKET_INTENT_FILE = "project/ticket-{NNN}/intent.json"
TICKET_LOG_FILE = "ai-{PROVIDER}-logs.txt"
TICKET_PARTICIPANT_PATTERN = [
  "user-{github_username}.md",
  "ai-{PROVIDER}.md",
  "preprompt.md",
  "changelog.md"
]

REPOSITORY_KIND IN [GOVERNANCE_AND_ONBOARDING_HUB, TARGET_SYSTEM]
ASSERT GOVERNANCE_HUB_MAINTENANCE_USES_OWN_TICKETS = VERIFIED_BY_CURRENT_FILES
ASSERT TARGET_SYSTEM_TICKETS_REMAIN_IN_TARGET_REPOSITORY = REQUIRED
ASSERT APPLICATION = VERIFIED_BY_CURRENT_FILES
ASSERT TESTS = VERIFIED_BY_CURRENT_FILES
ASSERT CI != VERIFIED_UNLESS_FILE_EXISTS
ASSERT TARGET_SYSTEM_DOCKER = REQUIRED
ASSERT GOVERNANCE_HUB_TEST_ENVIRONMENT = VERIFIED_BY_CI_WORKFLOW
```

## KONTEKST REPOZYTORIUM

```dsl
RULE C-CONTEXT-001
WHEN ROOT_REPOSITORY = "wellmanifest/new-project"
DO SET TASK_CONTEXT = GOVERNANCE_HUB_MAINTENANCE
DO REQUIRE EXACTLY_ONE_MATCHING_TICKET IN "project/ticket-{NNN}"
DO REQUIRE VALID_INTENT_AND_APPROVED_SCOPE
FORBID IMPORT_TARGET_SYSTEM_TICKET_TASK_OR_LOG
ASSERT HUB_CHANGE_IS_TRACKED_WITHIN_HUB

RULE C-CONTEXT-002
WHEN ROOT_REPOSITORY != "wellmanifest/new-project"
DO SET TASK_CONTEXT = TARGET_SYSTEM_DELIVERY
DO USE_TARGET_REPOSITORY_TICKET_LIFECYCLE
ASSERT TARGET_WORK_REMAINS_OUTSIDE_GOVERNANCE_HUB
```

## TICKETS

```dsl
RULE C-TICKET-001
WHEN TASK_STEPS > 1 OR AGENT_REQUIRED
DO ASSIGN UNIQUE TICKET_ID
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_DIRECTORY_PATTERN
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_SPEC_FILE
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_INDEX_FILE
ASSERT TASK_SCOPE_RECORDED_IN_SINGLE_TICKET_DIRECTORY

RULE C-TICKET-002
WHEN HUMAN_PARTICIPANT_STARTS_WORK
DO REQUIRE HUMAN_OR_TRUSTED_INTAKE_BOUNDARY_TO_CREATE "user-{github_username}.md"
FORBID AGENT_CREATE_OR_MODIFY "user-{github_username}.md"
ASSERT HUMAN_PARTICIPANT_CONTENT_HAS_HUMAN_OWNERSHIP

RULE C-TICKET-003
WHEN TICKET_CREATED
DO READ_TECHNICAL_DIRECTIVES IN "preprompt.md"
DO RECORD GOAL SCOPE RISKS ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA IN "ai-{PROVIDER}.md"
ASSERT AI_BRAIN_FILE_IS_AGENT_OWNED_INTERPRETATION_NOT_HUMAN_DECISION

RULE C-TICKET-004
WHEN PARTICIPANT_WORKS_ON_TICKET
DO WRITE_ONLY_OWNED_PARTICIPANT_FILE
DO RECORD ROLE_APPROPRIATE_TYPED_SECTIONS
ASSERT HUMAN_FILE_CONTAINS_HUMAN_INPUT_AND_AGENT_FILE_CONTAINS_AGENT_PLAN_OR_REPORT

RULE C-TICKET-005
WHEN COMMAND_TEST_OR_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_PRODUCED
DO APPEND RAW_OUTPUT_TO "ai-{PROVIDER}-logs.txt"
ASSERT RAW_LOGS_PRESERVED_IN_DEDICATED_PROVIDER_LOG_FILE

RULE C-TICKET-006
WHEN PROJECT_TODO_REFERENCES_TICKET
DO REFERENCE TICKET_DIRECTORY_PATTERN
ASSERT TODO_CONTAINS_PROJECT_LEVEL_INDEX_ONLY

RULE C-TICKET-007
WHEN TICKET_WORK_COMPLETED
DO PRESERVE_TICKET_DIRECTORY
ASSERT TICKET_DELETION_FORBIDDEN_WITHOUT_EXPLICIT_POST_PROJECT_USER_REQUEST

RULE C-TICKET-008
WHEN FOLLOWUP_PROMPT_OR_TASK_CONTINUATION_RECEIVED
DO REUSE_ACTIVE_TICKET_DIRECTORY WHEN WORKSTREAM_AND_SCOPE_MATCH
DO ALLOW_DISTINCT_ACTIVE_TICKET ONLY_WHEN MANIFEST_WORKSTREAM_DIFFERS AND WRITE_SCOPE_DOES_NOT_OVERLAP
DO UPDATE_SPECIFICATION_IN "ai-{PROVIDER}.md"
FORBID WRITE_OR_MODIFY "user-{github_username}.md"
FORBID CREATE_SPURIOUS_NEW_TICKET_DIRECTORY
ASSERT ACTIVE_TICKET_CONTINUED_UNTIL_EXPLICITLY_COMPLETED

RULE C-TICKET-009
WHEN PARTICIPANT_FILE_CREATED
DO REQUIRE EXPLICIT participant-id role ticket AND TYPED_SECTIONS
ASSERT HUMAN_AND_AGENT_INTENT_REMAIN_SEPARATE_AND_AUDITABLE

RULE C-TICKET-010
WHEN REQUIRED_RESPONSE_HAS_NO_TRUSTED_PARTICIPANT
DO SET responseRequiredFrom = ["unresolved:{required-role}"]
FORBID EMPTY_RESPONSE_ROUTE
FORBID IDENTITY_GUESSING
ASSERT UNRESOLVED_ROLE_EXPLICIT

RULE C-TICKET-011
WHEN TICKET_DIRECTORY_RECEIVES_FILE
DO ALLOW GOVERNANCE DECISION LOG OR CAPTURED_EVIDENCE
FORBID EXECUTABLE_SOURCE TEST OR RESEARCH_SCRIPT
ASSERT IMPLEMENTATION_STORED_OUTSIDE_TICKET_DIRECTORY

RULE C-TICKET-012
WHEN TICKET_INDEX_UPDATED
DO WRITE "project/TICKETS.md"
FORBID TAKE_OWNERSHIP_OF "project/README.md"
ASSERT EXISTING_ANALYSIS_README_PRESERVED

RULE C-TICKET-013
WHEN TICKET_CREATED_OR_SCOPE_CHANGED
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_INTENT_FILE WITH schema ticket summary workstream allowedPaths forbiddenPaths stacks dependsOn conflictsWith integrationTicket
DO RETURN_TO WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL
ASSERT IMPLEMENTATION_DIFF_IS_SUBSET_OF_ALLOWED_PATHS

RULE C-TICKET-015
WHEN MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_TICKETS_EXIST
DO REQUIRE DISTINCT_DECLARED_WORKSTREAMS AND NONOVERLAPPING_WRITE_SCOPES AND VALID_DEPENDENCY_DAG
DO REQUIRE EACH_IMPLEMENTATION_DIFF_RESOLVES_TO_EXACTLY_ONE_ACTIVE_TICKET
ASSERT PARALLELISM_IS_EXPLICIT_AND_DETERMINISTIC

RULE C-TICKET-017
WHEN TICKET_IS_WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL_OR_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY
DO SET STATUS IN [BACKLOG, PLAN, BLOCKED]
DO RELEASE_WORKSTREAM_AND_WRITE_SCOPE_RESERVATION
DO TRANSITION_TO IN_PROGRESS BEFORE EDIT
ASSERT ONLY_IN_PROGRESS_TICKET_IS_ACTIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_OWNER

RULE C-TICKET-016
WHEN SHARED_CONTRACT_PATH_CHANGES
DO REQUIRE MANIFEST_DECLARED_INTEGRATION_WORKSTREAM_AND VALID_INTEGRATION_TICKET
FORBID SILENT_SCOPE_EXPANSION
ASSERT CROSS_WORKSTREAM_CHANGE_HAS_FRESH_APPROVAL

RULE C-TICKET-014
WHEN APPROVAL_CLAIMED_FOR_MERGE
DO VERIFY TRUSTED_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_OR_SIGNED_ATTESTATION
FORBID ACCEPT_AGENT_WRITTEN_STATUS_AS_TRUSTED_APPROVAL
ASSERT APPROVAL_MATCHES_ACTIVE_TICKET_AND_CURRENT_DIFF
```

NEXT VALIDATION

## TOOLS

```dsl
RULE C-TOOLS-006
WHEN TARGET_SYSTEM_BOOTSTRAP_INITIATED
DO COPY_EXISTING_SCRIPTS_FROM_GOVERNANCE_HUB ("project.sh", "project.bat", "project/new-ticket.sh", "project/readme.sh", "project/governance-check.sh", "project/governance-check.bat")
DO RUN_IMMUTABLE_ADOPTION_GENERATOR ("scripts/create_adoption_lock.py" WITH FULL_PUBLISHED_SOURCE_REVISION)
DO COPY_PINNED_GOVERNANCE_PACKAGE (".governance/manifest.json", ".governance/manifest.lock.json", ".governance/governance_check.py", ".governance/stack-profiles.json", ".governance/lock.schema.json")
ASSERT SCRIPTS_COPIED_WITHOUT_REGENERATING_FROM_SCRATCH

RULE C-DOCS-001
WHEN SYSTEM_DESIGN_OR_FEATURE_PLANNED
DO CREATE_VISUAL_DIAGRAMS_IN_TARGET_PROJECT_DOCS ("docs/ARCHITECTURE.md", "docs/LOGIC_FLOW.md")
ASSERT VISUAL_DOCUMENTATION_PROVIDED_FOR_HUMANS_AND_AGENTS
```

## STATE

```dsl
STATE START
STATE ANALYSIS
STATE BACKLOG
STATE PLAN
STATE WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL
STATE TOOLS
STATE DELEGATION
STATE EDIT
STATE VALIDATION
STATE PUBLICATION
STATE DONE
STATE BLOCKED

TRANSITION START -> ANALYSIS
TRANSITION ANALYSIS -> BACKLOG WHEN WORK_IS_DEFERRED
TRANSITION BACKLOG -> PLAN WHEN PLANNING_RESUMES
TRANSITION ANALYSIS -> PLAN
TRANSITION PLAN -> WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL WHEN TICKET_CREATED_OR_SCOPE_CHANGED
TRANSITION PLAN -> TOOLS WHEN APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED
TRANSITION WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL -> PLAN WHEN SCOPE_CHANGED
TRANSITION WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL -> TOOLS WHEN EXPLICIT_INTERACTIVE_APPROVAL_RECEIVED
TRANSITION TOOLS -> DELEGATION
TRANSITION DELEGATION -> EDIT
TRANSITION EDIT -> VALIDATION
TRANSITION VALIDATION -> PUBLICATION
TRANSITION PUBLICATION -> DONE
TRANSITION ANY -> BLOCKED WHEN REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING
TRANSITION BLOCKED -> PLAN WHEN BLOCKER_RESOLVED_AND_SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED
TRANSITION BLOCKED -> IN_PROGRESS WHEN BLOCKER_RESOLVED_AND_APPROVED_SCOPE_UNCHANGED
```

## PROCEDURA START

```dsl
RULE C-START-001
WHEN TASK_RECEIVED
DO READ_RELEVANT_FILES
DO RUN "git status --short"
DO VERIFY "docker" COMMAND_EXISTS AND DOCKER_ENGINE_RUNNING WHEN TASK_CONTEXT = TARGET_SYSTEM_DELIVERY
DO VERIFY DECLARED_HUB_TEST_ENVIRONMENT WHEN TASK_CONTEXT = GOVERNANCE_HUB_MAINTENANCE
ASSERT WORKTREE_STATE_CAPTURED
ASSERT EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_STATUS = VERIFIED_OR_NOT_REQUIRED
NEXT ANALYSIS

RULE C-START-002
WHEN TASK_SCOPE_NOT_CLEAR
DO LIMIT_SCOPE_TO_USER_REQUEST
ASSERT SCOPE_MINIMAL
NEXT ANALYSIS

RULE C-START-003
WHEN TASK_STEPS > 1 OR AGENT_REQUIRED
DO IDENTIFY TICKET_ID OWNER AND PARTICIPANTS
DO READ TICKET_INDEX_FILE IF EXISTS
DO READ TICKET_SPEC_FILE IF EXISTS
DO READ RELEVANT_PARTICIPANT_FILES IF EXISTS
ASSERT TICKET_CONTEXT_CAPTURED
NEXT ANALYSIS
```

## PROCEDURA ANALYSIS

```dsl
RULE C-ANALYSIS-001
WHEN CLAIM_OR_TOOL_OR_WORKFLOW_REFERENCED
DO VERIFY_IN_CURRENT_FILES_OR_COMMAND_OUTPUT
ASSERT UNVERIFIED_ITEMS_ARE_LABELLED
NEXT PLAN

RULE C-ANALYSIS-002
WHEN project.sh IS_RELEVANT
DO DISTINGUISH ACTIVE_COMMANDS FROM COMMENTED_COMMANDS
ASSERT COMMENTED_COMMANDS_NOT_USED
NEXT PLAN

RULE C-ANALYSIS-003
WHEN REPOSITORY_FEATURE_NOT_FOUND
DO MARK FEATURE AS UNVERIFIED
ASSERT FEATURE_NOT_PRESENTED_AS_AVAILABLE
NEXT PLAN

RULE C-ANALYSIS-004
WHEN TARGET_SYSTEM_EXECUTION_OR_TESTS_REQUIRED
DO VERIFY DOCKER_CONFIGURATION
DO VERIFY REQUIRED_SERVICES_DEFINED
ASSERT EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_REPRODUCIBLE
NEXT PLAN OR BLOCKED
```

## PROCEDURA PLAN

```dsl
RULE C-PLAN-001
WHEN TASK_STEPS <= 1 AND AGENT_NOT_REQUIRED
DO KEEP_PLAN_INLINE
ASSERT TODO_NOT_REQUIRED
NEXT TOOLS

RULE C-PLAN-002
WHEN TASK_STEPS > 1 OR AGENT_REQUIRED
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE "TODO.md"
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_DIRECTORY_PATTERN
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_SPEC_FILE
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE TICKET_INDEX_FILE
DO RECORD SCOPE RISKS ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA STATUS
ASSERT TODO_CONTAINS_PROJECT_LEVEL_WORK_TRACKING
ASSERT TICKET_SPEC_FILE_CONTAINS_ASSIGNED_SCOPE
NEXT WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL

RULE C-PLAN-003
WHEN CHANGE_RISK_HIGH
DO RECORD RISK_AND_CHECKS
ASSERT RISK_VISIBLE_BEFORE_EDIT
NEXT WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL

RULE C-PLAN-004
WHEN PARTICIPANT_ASSIGNED
DO CREATE_OR_UPDATE OWNED_PARTICIPANT_FILE
DO RECORD ROLE INSTRUCTIONS AND IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN
FORBID AGENT_WRITE_HUMAN_PARTICIPANT_FILE
ASSERT IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_DOES_NOT_REDEFINE_TICKET_SCOPE
NEXT WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL
```

## PROCEDURA WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL

```dsl
RULE C-APPROVAL-001
WHEN ENTER WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL
DO PRESENT "project/ticket-{NNN}/ai-{PROVIDER}.md" AND "TODO.md" AND TICKET_INTENT_FILE
DO FORBID IMPLEMENTATION_FILE_CHANGE
ASSERT USER_CAN_REVIEW_UNDERSTANDING_CHECKLIST_AND_MACHINE_SCOPE
NEXT WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL

RULE C-APPROVAL-002
WHEN EXPLICIT_INTERACTIVE_APPROVAL_RECEIVED
DO RECORD_SESSION_AUTHORIZATION_IN_AGENT_OWNED_FILE
FORBID TREAT_SESSION_AUTHORIZATION_AS_TRUSTED_MERGE_APPROVAL
ASSERT IMPLEMENTATION_MAY_START_WITHIN_APPROVED_INTENT
NEXT TOOLS

RULE C-APPROVAL-003
WHEN TICKET_SCOPE_OR_INTENT_CHANGED
DO INVALIDATE_INTERACTIVE_APPROVAL
DO RETURN_TO PLAN
ASSERT FRESH_USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED
NEXT PLAN
```

NEXT PUBLICATION OR BLOCKED

RULE C-VALIDATION-007

DO RUN_HUB_TEST_CONTRACT

ASSERT HUB_CHANGE_IS_SCOPED_TESTED_AND_AUDITABLE
NEXT PUBLICATION OR BLOCKED

## CI GOVERNANCE GATE

```dsl
RULE C-CI-001
WHEN PULL_REQUEST_CHANGES_IMPLEMENTATION
DO REQUIRE CENTRAL_REUSABLE_WORKFLOW_PINNED_BY_COMMIT_SHA
DO REQUIRE EXTERNAL_REPOSITORY_RULESET_AND_CODEOWNER_REVIEW
DO REQUIRE MERGE_QUEUE WHEN PARALLEL_WORKSTREAMS_ENABLED
ASSERT TARGET_WORKFLOW_CANNOT_SELF_APPROVE_OR_BYPASS_REQUIRED_STATUS

RULE C-CI-002
WHEN STACK_DECLARED_IN_GOVERNANCE_MANIFEST
DO RUN_STACK_PROFILE_CHECKS_IN_PINNED_DOCKER_ENVIRONMENT
ASSERT TEST_EVIDENCE_AND_TOOL_AVAILABILITY_REPORTED

RULE C-CI-003
WHEN GOVERNANCE_OR_INTENT_CHECK_FAILS
DO EMIT GOV_CODE MESSAGE PATH EVIDENCE REMEDIATION
ASSERT MERGE_BLOCKED
```

## PROCEDURA PUBLICATION

```dsl
RULE C-PUBLISH-001
WHEN USER_DID_NOT_REQUEST_COMMIT
DO SKIP COMMIT
DO SKIP PUSH
ASSERT GIT_HISTORY_UNCHANGED
NEXT DONE

RULE C-PUBLISH-002
WHEN USER_REQUESTS_COMMIT
DO REVIEW "git status --short"
DO REVIEW "git diff"
DO COMMIT_ATOMIC_CHANGE
ASSERT COMMIT_DESCRIBES_REASON
NEXT DONE

RULE C-PUBLISH-003
WHEN USER_REQUESTS_PUSH
DO PUSH_ONLY_AFTER_COMMIT
ASSERT PUSH_TARGET_EXPLICIT
NEXT DONE
```

## FUNKCJA DONE

```dsl
DONE WHEN
  USER_SCOPE_COMPLETED
  AND TICKET_SCOPE_VALIDATED_WHEN_REQUIRED
  AND DIFF_REVIEWED
  AND SECRET_CHECK_DONE
  AND CLAIMS_VERIFIED_OR_LABELLED
  AND DOCKER_STATUS_VERIFIED
  AND DOCKER_VALIDATION_REPORTED_WHEN_RELEVANT
  AND TEST_STATUS_REPORTED
  AND COMMIT_PUSH_STATUS_REPORTED

REPORT MUST_INCLUDE [
  SUMMARY,
  TICKET_REFERENCE,
  PARTICIPANTS,
  COMPLETED_SCOPE,
  UNFINISHED_SCOPE,
  CHANGED_BLOCKS,
  PRESERVED_ELEMENTS,
  CHECKS_RUN,
  DOCKER_STATUS,
  TEST_STATUS,
  LOG_FILE_REFERENCE,
  LIMITATIONS
]
```
